From single job vacancies to large-scale projects, our proficiency in providing exceptional professionals across the board has carved our reputation as a secure and significant supplier partner.

   Gaining market share, year-on-year, we have the largest client base of any IT recruitment business across Europe. We work with a range of clients, from SMEs to large multi-nationals and high-profile names. 

   Passionate about recruitment, our 350+ specialist IT recruitment consultants' priority is to secure the right person for the right role, within a specified timeframe and budget. Through Computer Futures' methodology, our consultants - who focus on a specific IT technical market and geographical area - create a bespoke service to meet our individual clients' recruitment needs.

         

   Job Description       Position Summary:


   The Business Systems Analyst works with internal and external clients and the development and testing teams to ensure that requests for the development and enhancement of internally developed software applications/systems meet the needs/expectations of the business users. The Business Systems Analyst is the liaison between the software users and the software developers. They convey the demands of the software users to the developers.

   Responsibilities: 

    The individual will elicit and document business, functional, non-functional and transition requirements and business rules.

    The Business Systems Analyst may work individually or in conjunction with other Business Systems Analysts, Senior Business Systems Analysts or Lead Business Systems Analysts on projects of varying size and scope.

   Duties and Responsibilities: 

    Elicit, capture, and document rules and requirements for software/systems development projects

    Produce appropriate models/diagrams to support the requirements elicitation process

    Facilitate requirement review sessions with business and technical stakeholders to ensure common understanding of documented requirements

    Participate in reviews of peer requirements documentation

         

   Qualifications       Minimum Qualifications:

    Bachelor's Degree

    Background in eliciting and documenting software/system requirements

    Experience interacting with business, development, and testing resources

    Experience in meeting facilitation, interviewing and other techniques related to the elicitation of requirements

    Experience completing multiple projects with conflicting deadlines in a fast paced environment

    Experience using Requirements Management tools (ALM)

    Experience in Microsoft Excel creating formulas and pivot tables and in using macros and the vLookups function.

    Experience creating databases and reports using Microsoft Access or other similar database software.

    Experience using report writing tools, i.e. Crystal Reports or SAS.

    Experience creating presentations in Microsoft PowerPoint.

    Experience analyzing data, data mining, managing projects and identifying trends.

   Preferred Qualifications:

    Bachelor's Degree in any IT related field

    IIBA (CCBA) Certification

    Basic skill or facility in estimating work effort and planning and managing schedules

    Process modeling

    Exposure to a broad range of project types, including new development, enhancements, COTS implementations

    Experience in the Healthcare domain

    Experience using ALM as a Requirements Management tool

    Six Sigma training or experience Compliance & Regulatory

    Experience managing reports in Microsoft Outlook or other communication base systems in order to optimize utilization.

    General understanding of software design and development.

    Ability to communicate clearly in written and verbal form.

    Ability to create effective job aides and review them with key stakeholders at multiple levels of the department and organization.

         

   Additional Information       All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

   Phone: 346 231 7544

   Email: d.garan@computerfutures. com
